name: OceanToken
tagline: Search and price 480+ AI models, and generate images, video and speech from one prepaid balance
description:
A remote MCP server for OceanToken, a pay-as-you-go API for models from many labs. Your agent can search the model catalog by type, capability and price, estimate what a request will cost before it runs, generate images, video and voice-overs, transcribe audio into transcripts or SRT/VTT subtitles, and hand a sub-task to another model. Usage is billed to your prepaid OceanToken balance.

Tools: `search_models`, `get_model`, `estimate_cost`, `generate_image`, `create_video`, `get_job`, `generate_speech`, `transcribe_audio`, `ask_model`, `upload_file`, `get_account`.

install.notes: Needs an OceanToken account with credit (https://app.oceantoken.ai/ui/signup/). The server uses OAuth: sign in when Cline first connects. Generated files are returned as links that expire after about 24 hours, so download the ones you need.
